findings: No defect found in the PR. All four acceptance lines pass.
Pre-existing (not this PR, LEGION-13): cli `legion start --check-config` test fails when DISPATCH_URL is set without DISPATCH_TOKEN in the real environment.

Tester-process note, not a daemon bug: the pi-envoy extension prepends exactly one `export LEGION_GRANT=…` block to each bash call; if that block gets duplicated in the command text the last (fake) export wins and `legion gh` fails with `Unable to redeem LEGION_GRANT (403)`. Worked around with /tmp/legion11-smoke/with-grant.sh, which mints a grant through the daemon's own /worker-session recovery route (boot token -> capability -> grant) and execs the credential command; nothing secret is printed.
